_comment: Incompatible role pairs. Adjust to match your application's roles.

conflicts.risk: A user could create a fictitious vendor and approve payments to it.
A user could create and approve their own purchases.
A user could order and confirm receipt of goods that never arrived.
A user could record and approve their own journal entries.
A user could add a payee or change pay and approve the payroll run.
A user could change customer records to conceal diverted receipts.
A user could grant themselves any access and approve payments.
A user could grant themselves access and approve entries.
